founder_intent.primary_user: Professional cadastral surveyor working on Sabah cadastral survey workflows
founder_intent.core_problem: Cadastral field, computation, geometry, QA/QC, plan and deliverable workflows require a professional software environment without weakening numerical correctness, regulatory provenance or human survey authority.
founder_intent.desired_outcome: Use VL as a controlled software factory for e-BKL SurveyOS while preserving the authoritative e-BKL repository, verified numerical behaviour, fail-closed cadastral governance and explicit human release decisions.
must_have: All official e-BKL work categories must remain represented under FIELD, COMPUTE, CADASTRAL and DELIVER
Strict numeric input validation and explicit CRS/datum state
Golden Sample regression infrastructure with evidence classification and provenance
Production release requires explicit human approval
must_not: Do not invent cadastral formulas, tolerances, thresholds, regulatory rules or authoritative source claims
Do not auto-move or auto-resolve cadastral boundaries
Do not treat supplemental or comparison-only evidence as authoritative Golden truth
Do not merge to e-BKL main automatically
Do not deploy or mutate e-BKL production automatically
Do not enable official/submission-ready outputs while required gates remain blocked
founder_intent.success_metric: VL-generated e-BKL changes pass the e-BKL branch CI/test suite, preserve all numerical/governance locks, maintain traceability to requirements and require human review before merge or production release.
founder_intent.commercial_model: Proprietary professional cadastral survey software; commercial decisions remain outside autonomous VL build authority.
compliance_constraints: Sabah cadastral and land-survey rules must be backed by verified authoritative sources before enforcement
CRS and datum must be explicit
Numerical correctness has priority over cosmetics
Boundary evidence conflicts require professional human review
founder_intent.release_scope: Development and pull-request preparation only. No autonomous merge to e-BKL main and no autonomous production deployment.
human_decision_boundaries: Approval of authoritative cadastral formulas and numerical baselines
Approval of regulatory tolerances, thresholds and rule profiles
Resolution of boundary conflicts or survey evidence conflicts
Acceptance or rejection of cadastral survey results
Promotion of evidence to authoritative Golden status

user_requirements.context: VL is modifying e-BKL source code
user_requirements.expected_outcome: Numerical and cadastral governance boundaries are preserved and changes are traceable.

user_requirements.context: A boundary, regulatory or Golden evidence state is unresolved
user_requirements.expected_outcome: VL and e-BKL fail closed and require human review rather than manufacturing acceptance.

user_requirements.context: VL has completed a development change
user_requirements.expected_outcome: The result remains branch/PR scoped until explicit human merge and production approval.

user_requirements.context: VL generates or modifies UI and workflow code
user_requirements.expected_outcome: All eight primary SurveyOS screens and 46 official work categories remain compatible with the governed architecture.

acceptance_tests.observable_pass_condition: The authoritative e-BKL branch test suite and syntax checks pass after a VL-generated change.
No VL project policy grants authority to change formulas, tolerances, CRS assumptions, boundary positions or production state autonomously.
Unverified rules or evidence remain BLOCKED/NOT_VERIFIED and boundary conflicts remain HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
VL e-BKL policy states development/PR-only authority; automatic merge and production deploy are prohibited.
